resourceProfile.assessment: Selected Indonesian after comparing effective cross-surface samples across locales: runtime, quad-coil, nicotine-base and stranded-wire wrong-sense translations gave the clearest cross-surface defect evidence. Queue priority is not a quality score; selection is sample-based. Independent review covered all 1115 canonical semantic entries, followed by route metadata and Ohm sentence composition. Canonical English, glossary, UI, and local technical articles were available.
limitations: Model critique does not constitute competent human review or a global exhaustive locale ranking.
Existing machine-draft status and correction feedback remain enabled.

automatedQuality.summary: Passed translation metadata and queue validation, TypeScript, all 572 tests in 85 files, full production build, 61 route cases and generated-link checks across 10279 HTML files. Browser smoke checks passed on 15 Indonesian routes; battery, mod-range and Ohm desktop/mobile screenshots were inspected with no horizontal overflow. Result rendering used repository-derived API fixtures because the live calculation requests did not complete in the preview. The IIS broker verified the switch to the built blue slot; browser checks used the generated artifact through the local static server, not a verified IIS public URL.

linguisticCritique.summary: Independent agent reviewed all 1115 effective entries: messages 308, calculators.batt 67, calculators.coil 80, calculators.converter 25, calculators.juice 55, calculators.modrange 49, calculators.tcr 42, calculators.wirewiz 101, comparisons.batteries 26, comparisons.mods 11, comparisons.materials 19, catalog 295, catalogText 37. Follow-up verified 49 overrides and identified one optional Ohm label, sentence composition, and two route descriptions. These were corrected, yielding 52 distinct corrected display entries.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Indonesian human review was performed.

publicationAuthorization.summary: User requested review, improvement and commit; no production publication.

Restore measured as-sold dimension notes instruction: Gunakan catatan untuk mengukur says use the notes to perform measurement. The source says the notes store measured as-sold dimensions. Paket mod also omits battery.
evidence: English: Enter at least one continuous discharge limit. Integrated batteries are internal mod packs, so standalone cell dimensions are not required. Removable-cell dimensions are nominal; use the notes for measured as-sold dimensions. When both discharge limits are set, the calculator continues to use the safer derived limit if they differ materially.

Dimensi sel yang dapat dilepas bersifat nominal; gunakan catatan untuk mengukur dimensi produk yang dijual. findings.resolution: Masukkan setidaknya satu batas pengosongan kontinu. Baterai terintegrasi merupakan paket baterai internal mod, sehingga dimensi sel individual tidak diperlukan. Dimensi sel yang dapat dilepas bersifat nominal; gunakan catatan untuk mencantumkan dimensi terukur produk sebagaimana dijual. Jika kedua batas pengosongan ditetapkan dan berbeda secara signifikan, kalkulator tetap menggunakan batas hasil perhitungan yang lebih aman.

findings.summary: Restore wire gauge system identity and table heading: Pengukur denotes a measuring instrument rather than the gauge size system. Keep Standard Wire Gauge as the named system and use glossary gauge kawat terminology.
Make increasing AWG number unambiguous: Menambah ukuran sebanyak tiga ukuran can mean increasing physical size; the source says increase the gauge number by three, which reduces physical area.
evidence: English: Resistance depends on conductor length L, cross-sectional area A, and material resistivity ρ. Because area varies with the square of diameter, a modest diameter difference can make a substantial resistance difference. In AWG, increasing the gauge by three sizes approximately halves area and doubles resistance per unit length for the same material and temperature.

Previous Indonesian: Resistansi tergantung pada panjang konduktor L, luas penampang A, dan resistivitas material ρ. Karena luas bervariasi dengan kuadrat diameter, perbedaan diameter yang kecil dapat menimbulkan perbedaan resistansi yang besar. Dalam AWG, menambah ukuran sebanyak tiga ukuran kira-kira akan mengurangi separuh luas dan menggandakan resistansi per satuan panjang untuk material dan suhu yang sama.
findings.resolution: Resistansi bergantung pada panjang konduktor L, luas penampang A, dan resistivitas material ρ. Karena luas berubah sebanding dengan kuadrat diameter, perbedaan diameter yang kecil dapat menimbulkan perbedaan resistansi yang besar. Dalam AWG, menaikkan nomor gauge sebanyak tiga kira-kira mengurangi luas menjadi separuh dan menggandakan resistansi per satuan panjang untuk material dan suhu yang sama.

findings.summary: Restore through-layer temperature difference: Antar lapisan means between layers. The source difference is across the thickness of one layer.
evidence: English: ΔT is the temperature difference across the layer.
Previous Indonesian: ΔT adalah perbedaan suhu antar lapisan.
findings.resolution: ΔT adalah perbedaan suhu antara kedua sisi lapisan.

findings.summary: Distinguish mechanical strain from pressure: Tekanan mekanis means mechanical pressure; the source specifies strain, or regangan.
evidence: English: A manufacturer's TCR normally applies to a stated temperature and resistance range. Temperature gradients, material changes, contacts, mechanical strain, and self-heating can make a real result differ from the first-order estimate.

Previous Indonesian: TCR pabrikan biasanya berlaku pada kisaran suhu dan resistansi yang ditentukan. Gradien suhu, perubahan material, kontak, tekanan mekanis, dan pemanasan sendiri dapat membuat hasil nyata berbeda dari perkiraan tingkat pertama.
findings.resolution: TCR pabrikan biasanya berlaku pada rentang suhu dan resistansi yang ditentukan. Gradien suhu, perubahan material, kontak, regangan mekanis, dan pemanasan sendiri dapat membuat hasil nyata berbeda dari perkiraan orde pertama.

findings.summary: Use specific heat consistently: Panas spesifik is a literal rendering that breaks the established capacity terminology used in the same article.
evidence: English: The simple equation assumes specific heat is roughly constant. Heat loss, convection, radiation, evaporation, contact resistance, and uneven temperature can make a real result differ from the ideal.

Previous Indonesian: Persamaan sederhana mengasumsikan panas spesifik kira-kira konstan. Kehilangan panas, konveksi, radiasi, penguapan, resistansi kontak, dan suhu yang tidak merata dapat membuat hasil nyata berbeda dari ideal.
findings.resolution: Persamaan sederhana mengasumsikan kapasitas kalor spesifik kurang lebih konstan. Kehilangan panas, konveksi, radiasi, penguapan, resistansi kontak, dan suhu yang tidak merata dapat membuat hasil nyata berbeda dari hasil ideal.
